story_type: last-second hoist as a dinghy sinks (infrared)
hook: His dinghy was sinking. He made a Mayday call.
narration: This twelve foot dinghy was sinking less than a mile off Fort De Soto, Florida.
The fisherman aboard got out a Mayday call.
A Coast Guard Jayhawk crew found him.
The camera is infrared, so warm bodies show dark against the water.
[short pause] The crew got him out moments before the boat went down.
outcome: The Clearwater aircrew rescued the fisherman just before his dinghy sank.
title: Dinghy sinking, he called Mayday
description:
On March 23, 2017, a Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater MH-60 Jayhawk crew rescued a fisherman moments before his 12-foot dinghy sank less than a mile west of Fort De Soto, Florida.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Clearwater, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/515565
